propositions: Jira workflows may forbid direct end-state transitions (e.g. open->done when only open->in_progress->done is allowed), causing outbound sync to fail and ticket status to drift.
The current implementation attempts one hop via transition_issue_by_name and gives up on failure, falling back to comment-only without advancing status.
A new replay mechanism must walk the recorded sequence of status hops from event-sourced STATUS events, forward-mapped to Jira names, to reach the target state via allowed intermediate transitions.
Replay resumes from the issue's current Jira status by direct name matching (without inverting the non-injective LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA map) and replays only the remaining unexecuted hops in order.
On any hop raising RuntimeError, ValueError, IllegalTransitionError, or HTTPError, replay aborts and falls through to the existing comment-fallback + drift behavior.
The replay call is threaded into _update_one_scalar_update by adding local_id as an optional parameter and calling replay_transition before comment-fallback.
